title.en: The Victoria Cross and those who received it
title.fr: La Croix de Victoria et ceux qui l'ont reçue

text.en: Since 1854, the Victoria Cross has gone to 96 Canadians.
text.fr: Depuis 1854, la Croix de Victoria a été décernée à 96 Canadiens.

source.quote: The V.C. has been awarded to 96 Canadians since 1854

text.en: Lieutenant Alexander Roberts Dunn was born in the place that is Toronto today.
text.fr: Le lieutenant Alexander Roberts Dunn est né là où se trouve aujourd'hui Toronto.

source.quote: Then lieutenant Alexander Roberts Dunn, born in present-day Toronto

text.en: Corporal Filip Konowal was born in Ukraine. In 1917, at the Battle of Hill 70, he showed great courage.
text.fr: Le caporal Filip Konowal est né en Ukraine. En 1917, à la bataille de la cote 70, il a fait preuve d'un grand courage.

source.quote: Corporal Filip Konowal, born in Ukraine, showed exceptional courage in the Battle of Hill 70 in 1917

text.en: Filip Konowal was the first in the Canadian Corps to win the Victoria Cross who had been born outside the British Empire.
text.fr: Filip Konowal a été le premier membre du Corps canadien né hors de l'Empire britannique à recevoir la Croix de Victoria.

source.quote: became the first member of the Canadian Corps not born in the British Empire to be awarded the V.C.

text.en: Captain Billy Bishop was a flying ace born in Owen Sound, Ontario. He earned the Victoria Cross with the Royal Flying Corps in the First World War.
text.fr: Le capitaine Billy Bishop était un as de l'aviation né à Owen Sound, en Ontario. Il a reçu la Croix de Victoria dans le Royal Flying Corps pendant la Première Guerre mondiale.

source.quote: Flying ace Captain Billy Bishop, born in Owen Sound, Ontario, earned the V.C. in the Royal Flying Corps during the First World War

text.en: Billy Bishop later held the honorary rank of Air Marshal in the Royal Canadian Air Force.
text.fr: Billy Bishop a plus tard porté le grade honorifique de maréchal de l'air dans l'Aviation royale canadienne.

source.quote: was later an honorary Air Marshal of the Royal Canadian Air Force

text.en: Captain Paul Triquet came from Cabano, Quebec. In 1943, during the Second World War, he led his men and a few tanks in an attack at Casa Berardi, in Italy. He earned the Victoria Cross for it.
text.fr: Le capitaine Paul Triquet venait de Cabano, au Québec. En 1943, pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, il a mené ses hommes et quelques chars à l'attaque de Casa Berardi, en Italie. Il a reçu la Croix de Victoria pour cette action.

source.quote: Captain Paul Triquet of Cabano, Quebec, earned the V.C. leading his men and a handful of tanks in the attack on Casa Berardi in Italy in 1943 during the Second World War

text.en: Paul Triquet later reached the rank of Brigadier.
text.fr: Paul Triquet a plus tard atteint le grade de brigadier.
